name: Sonagiga Naerineun Gonggan
source:
“Everyone hides something.”  

But when the silence ties to survival, the truth begins to shake.

'A Place Where Summer Rain Falls' is a story-driven visual novel set in a rainy school, where hidden memories and quiet emotions unfold.  

The truth isn't always loud — sometimes, it's silent.

[From [url=https://bulhwa.itch.io/a-place-where-summer-rain-falls]itch.io[/url]]
